changes.before: Active as of 2026-09-23. Confirmed via Door County's own official board minutes (reproduced in the June 23, 2026 agenda packet): Resolution 2026-41 was adopted by voice vote at the May 26, 2026 County Board meeting, imposing a moratorium on data centers and battery energy storage systems in unincorporated Door County "for a period of up to twelve (12) months from the date of this resolution," i.e. through approximately 2027-05-26, with the Board retaining the right to extend by separate action. No extension, repeal, or rescission was found as of 2026-09-23.

changes.before: Active as of 2026-09-23; adopted 5-0 on July 13, 2026. Prohibits issuance of zoning certificates for data centers with floor area greater than 10,000 square feet for 12 months following the effective date, or until a data-center ordinance is adopted, whichever is earlier; extendable up to 6 additional months per Wis. Stat. § 66.1002(3)(b)2. Village staff are directed to draft permanent data-center regulations before the moratorium expires.
